description: Domain-adaptive 6-pillar completeness and reproducibility rubric for Methods & Experiments academic writing.

method_steps.check_guidance: Present an ordered, executable sequence with explicit input, action, output, and stopping/decision criteria rather than collapsing multiple operations into one vague sentence.

experimental_setup.check_guidance: Strictly separate Training/Validation/Testing (or Synthesis/Characterization/Testing) conditions so hyperparameters or sample treatments never bleed across stages.

parameters_and_provenance.check_guidance: Every parameter must carry name, exact value, unit, target scope, and concrete source (config/log/code/paper/author_confirm), and prose values must match the table 100%.

datasets_and_splits.label_zh: 数据集与划分 / 样本与材料
datasets_and_splits.check_guidance: Specify exact dataset version/snapshot (or reagent grade/batch), sample counts, leakage-free preprocessing, split ratios & randomization strategy, and role of every subset.

baselines_and_controls.check_guidance: Identify exact baseline versions/implementations, explicitly state whether compute/resource/experimental budgets are matched (or document asymmetry), define metrics precisely, and specify statistical reporting.

reproducibility_and_limitations.check_guidance: Deliver an actionable reproduction checklist and ground every limitation in a concrete failure scenario, trigger condition, and validity boundary (no generic boilerplate).

ml_computational.name: Ordered pipeline steps (input/op/output/stop)
ml_computational.question_zh: 请确认方法流程中各步骤的精确输入、操作顺序、中间输出及终止/收敛判断条件。
ml_computational.question_en: Please confirm the exact input, operation sequence, intermediate output, and stopping/convergence criterion for each step.

ml_computational.name: Train/Val/Test stage separation
ml_computational.question_zh: 请确认训练、验证与测试阶段的超参数、批大小及前处理流程是否完全一致，是否存在阶段差异。
ml_computational.question_en: Please confirm whether hyperparameters, batch sizes, and preprocessing differ across training, validation, and testing.

ml_computational.name: Hardware & software/library versions
ml_computational.question_zh: 请补充实验运行的硬件规格（GPU/CPU 型号与数量）及核心软件/框架版本号（Python、PyTorch/CUDA 等）。
ml_computational.question_en: Please provide the hardware specs (GPU/CPU model & count) and core software/framework versions (Python, PyTorch, CUDA, etc.).

ml_computational.name: Random seeds & repeat counts
ml_computational.question_zh: 请确认实验使用的全部随机种子取值及独立重复实验次数（或交叉验证折数）。
ml_computational.question_en: Please confirm the exact random seed(s) and number of independent runs (or CV folds).

ml_computational.name: Core optimization & model hyperparameters
ml_computational.question_zh: 请核实模型与优化核心超参数（学习率、批大小、训练轮数、优化器、正则化等）的最终生效取值及其配置来源。
ml_computational.question_en: Please verify the final effective values and config sources for core model and optimization hyperparameters.

ml_computational.name: Dataset version, scale, preprocessing & split strategy
ml_computational.question_zh: 请确认数据集的精确版本号/快照日期、样本总量、预处理是否仅在训练集拟合，以及划分比例与随机方式。
ml_computational.question_en: Please confirm the exact dataset version/snapshot, sample count, train-only preprocessing details, and split ratios/strategy.

ml_computational.name: Baseline versions, budget parity & statistical metrics
ml_computational.question_zh: 请确认各基线模型的精确版本/代码实现、与主方法是否采用同等计算与调参预算，以及指标聚合与统计检验方式。
ml_computational.question_en: Please confirm exact baseline versions/implementations, compute/tuning budget parity, and metric aggregation/statistical tests.

ml_computational.name: Code commit, exact CLI commands & data access
ml_computational.question_zh: 请补充用于复现的代码仓库版本/Commit Hash、完整执行命令及数据获取方式/访问许可。
ml_computational.question_en: Please provide the exact code repository commit hash, reproduction CLI commands, and data access/licensing details.

ml_computational.name: Concrete failure-mode limitations & validity scope
ml_computational.question_zh: 请确认本方法在具体失效场景（如极端分布偏移、小样本、高噪声、硬件受限等）下的适用边界与失效表现。
ml_computational.question_en: Please confirm the concrete failure scenarios, trigger regimes, and validity boundaries of the method.

wetlab_chem_bio_materials.name: Executable synthesis/assay SOP steps
wetlab_chem_bio_materials.question_zh: 请确认每一步合成/测试操作的具体投料、操作条件、中间产物及终点判据（时间、温度、pH 或色变）。
wetlab_chem_bio_materials.question_en: Please confirm exact inputs, operating steps, intermediate products, and endpoint criteria for each synthesis/assay step.

wetlab_chem_bio_materials.name: Instruments, models, calibration & replicates
wetlab_chem_bio_materials.question_zh: 请补充各表征/测试仪器的精确型号、厂商、校准条件及独立平行实验重复次数（n）。
wetlab_chem_bio_materials.question_en: Please provide exact instrument models, manufacturers, calibration protocols, and independent replicate counts (n).

wetlab_chem_bio_materials.name: Operating parameters (T, P, flow, time, dosage, heating rate)
wetlab_chem_bio_materials.question_zh: 请核实关键工艺与测试参数（温度、压力、气液流速、升温速率、反应时间、投料比等）的精确数值、单位与记录来源。
wetlab_chem_bio_materials.question_en: Please verify exact values, units, and log sources for operating parameters (T, P, flow rate, ramp rate, duration, dosage).

wetlab_chem_bio_materials.name: Reagents/materials grade, supplier, batch & sample grouping
wetlab_chem_bio_materials.question_zh: 请补充所有关键试剂/原料的纯度等级、供应商、批次信息及样品分组/预处理方式。
wetlab_chem_bio_materials.question_en: Please provide purity grades, suppliers, batch/lot numbers, and sample preparation/grouping rules for all key reagents/materials.

wetlab_chem_bio_materials.name: Blank/positive/negative controls & statistical error bars
wetlab_chem_bio_materials.question_zh: 请确认空白对照/阳性对照/商业参比样品的规格、是否在同一测试条件下同基准对比，以及误差棒/统计检验定义。
wetlab_chem_bio_materials.question_en: Please confirm blank/positive/commercial reference specs, matched test conditions, and error-bar/statistical test definitions.

wetlab_chem_bio_materials.name: Safety/environmental sensitivity & failure modes
wetlab_chem_bio_materials.question_zh: 请确认实验对环境条件（湿度/氧含量/活化步骤）的敏感性及明确的材料/工艺失效边界。
wetlab_chem_bio_materials.question_en: Please confirm environmental sensitivities (humidity/O2/activation) and concrete failure-mode boundaries.

simulation_engineering.name: Governing equations, discretization & solver workflow
simulation_engineering.question_zh: 请确认控制方程假设、空间/时间离散格式、求解顺序及残差收敛判据。
simulation_engineering.question_en: Please confirm governing equations, discretization schemes, solver sequence, and convergence criteria.

simulation_engineering.name: Solver software version, hardware & numerical precision
simulation_engineering.question_zh: 请补充仿真软件精确版本、编译/并行环境、数值精度及网格/时间步长无关性验证情况。
simulation_engineering.question_en: Please provide exact simulation software versions, parallel runtime specs, numerical precision, and mesh/timestep independence checks.

simulation_engineering.name: Physical constants, force-field/material params & boundary values
simulation_engineering.question_zh: 请核实所有物性参数、力场/本构模型参数与边界条件取值的来源及量纲单位。
simulation_engineering.question_en: Please verify values, SI units, and provenance for all physical properties, constitutive/force-field parameters, and boundary values.

simulation_engineering.name: Geometry/input structures & validation datasets
simulation_engineering.question_zh: 请确认几何模型/初始构型文件版本、尺寸规模及用于校准与验证的实验/参考数据集划分。
simulation_engineering.question_en: Please confirm geometry/initial structure versions, domain sizes, and calibration vs. validation benchmark data.

simulation_engineering.name: Reference models, analytical benchmarks & error metrics
simulation_engineering.question_zh: 请确认对照模型/解析解基准及其网格/算力预算一致性与误差度量公式。
simulation_engineering.question_en: Please confirm reference/analytical benchmarks, grid/compute parity, and exact error metric definitions.

simulation_engineering.name: Input decks, random seeds & physical validity regime
simulation_engineering.question_zh: 请补充输入卡/运行命令获取方式，并明确模型假设失效的物理参数区间。
simulation_engineering.question_en: Please provide input deck access/commands and specify the physical parameter regimes where model assumptions break down.

general_scientific.name: Ordered executable steps (input/action/output/stop)
general_scientific.question_zh: 请确认完整实验/分析流程的每一步输入、操作动作、输出产物及判断/终止条件。
general_scientific.question_en: Please confirm exact input, action, output, and stopping/decision criteria for each procedural step.

general_scientific.name: Stage separation, hardware/software env, seeds & repeats
general_scientific.question_zh: 请确认各阶段实验条件的分离情况、软硬件/仪器版本、随机化设置及重复次数。
general_scientific.question_en: Please confirm stage separation, hardware/software/instrument versions, randomization, and repeat counts.

general_scientific.name: Complete parameter provenance table
general_scientific.question_zh: 请确认所有关键参数的取值、单位、作用对象及原始记录来源。
general_scientific.question_en: Please confirm values, units, target scope, and exact raw sources for all key parameters.

general_scientific.name: Data/materials version, scale, preprocessing & splits
general_scientific.question_zh: 请确认数据/材料的精确版本、规模、预处理流程、划分比例及各子集用途。
general_scientific.question_en: Please confirm exact data/material versions, scale, preprocessing, split ratios, and subset roles.

general_scientific.name: Controls/baselines, parity, metrics & statistics
general_scientific.question_zh: 请确认对照对象版本、条件/预算是否等价、评价指标定义及统计检验方式。
general_scientific.question_en: Please confirm control/baseline versions, parity of conditions/budgets, metric definitions, and statistical methods.

general_scientific.name: Reproduction checklist & failure-mode limitations
general_scientific.question_zh: 请补充复现所需的代码/协议版本、运行命令、数据获取方式，以及具体失效场景与适用范围。
general_scientific.question_en: Please provide reproduction code/protocol version, commands, data access, and concrete failure scenarios/scope.
